snapshot.title: Field Report: Eastfield Pump Station Pump Anomaly

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Field Operations
fields.summary: The local HMI at the Eastfield Pump Station shows P-501 and P-502 running in AUTO mode, but the discharge pressure PIT-641 is stuck at 22 psi. The pumps are vibrating and producing a loud, increasing mechanical noise. The bearing sensor on P-501 reads 110°F, but the HMI shows 85°F. The site radio is dead, and I am calling from my personal cell. No visible leaks or smoke. The pressure-sustaining valve PSV-501 is fully open and not cycling.

findings.notes: Vibrating, loud noise, bearing temp 110°F (HMI shows 85°F)
Vibrating, noise level increasing, no visible abnormalities
Stuck at 22 psi; no change since 08:45
Shows stable values but contradicts on-site bearing sensor
No hot air or smoke detected

actionsTaken: Confirmed pump vibration and noise on-site
Verified HMI pressure reading (22 psi) against local gauge (same value)
Attempted radio call to Control — no response
Initiated manual shutdown via local control panel on P-501 (confirmed)
recommendations: Shut down P-501 and P-502 via local HOA switches immediately
Dispatch maintenance crew to Eastfield for mechanical inspection and bearing replacement
Verify HMI data integrity on RTU-05; isolate if telemetry is corrupted
Report any additional anomalies to Control via personal cell until radio restored
fields.photosNote: 4 photos attached: IMG_EFS-01 (P-501 vibration), IMG_EFS-02 (bearing sensor), IMG_EFS-03 (local HMI), IMG_EFS-04 (noise source near coupling) — all timestamped 09:00

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The HMI is still unreliable, so validate on-site.
